purpose: Child skills needed by the first three roadmap trees (Software Engineer, Data Analyst, AI/ML Engineer). Imported as CANDIDATES; nothing is active until a reviewer runs `roadmap:content skills activate`.

skills.name: Variables and Control Flow
skills.description: Declares and updates variables and uses conditions and loops to control what a program does.

skills.name: Functions and Scope
skills.description: Breaks code into functions with clear inputs and outputs and understands where a name is visible.

skills.name: Error Handling and Debugging
skills.description: Finds the cause of a failing program with a systematic method and handles errors without hiding them.

skills.name: Arrays and Strings
skills.description: Stores and transforms sequences of values and text, and knows the cost of common operations on them.

skills.name: Linked List Operations
skills.description: Builds and manipulates singly and doubly linked lists, including insertion, deletion and reversal.

skills.name: Stacks and Queues
skills.description: Uses last-in-first-out and first-in-first-out structures and recognises the problems they suit.

skills.name: Hash Maps and Hashing
skills.description: Uses key-value lookup in constant expected time and reasons about collisions and load.

skills.name: Trees and Binary Search Trees
skills.description: Represents hierarchical data, traverses trees and keeps ordered data in a binary search tree.

skills.name: Heaps and Priority Queues
skills.description: Maintains the smallest or largest item efficiently and applies it to scheduling and top-k problems.

skills.name: Sorting and Searching Algorithms
skills.description: Chooses and implements common sorting and searching methods and compares their running time.

skills.name: Recursion and Backtracking Patterns
skills.description: Solves problems by breaking them into smaller copies of themselves and exploring choices with undo.

skills.name: Dynamic Programming Patterns
skills.description: Solves overlapping-subproblem tasks by defining a state, a recurrence and an order of evaluation.

skills.name: Greedy Algorithm Design
skills.description: Builds a solution from locally best choices and judges when that is provably enough.

skills.name: Classes and Encapsulation
skills.description: Models things as classes, hides internal state and exposes a small, clear interface.

skills.name: Inheritance and Polymorphism
skills.description: Reuses behaviour through inheritance and composition and writes code that works on many types.

skills.name: Object-Oriented Design Patterns
skills.description: Recognises and applies common object-oriented solutions such as factory, observer and strategy.

skills.name: Git Fundamentals
skills.description: Tracks changes with commits, inspects history and undoes mistakes safely using Git.

skills.name: Branching and Merging
skills.description: Works on parallel lines of development and combines them, resolving conflicts correctly.

skills.name: Code Review Practice
skills.description: Gives and receives pull-request feedback that improves correctness and readability.

skills.name: Unit Testing Practice
skills.description: Writes small automated tests for one behaviour at a time, with clear arrange-act-assert structure.

skills.name: Integration Testing
skills.description: Tests how components work together, including databases and external services, with controlled test data.

skills.name: Test-Driven Development
skills.description: Drives a design by writing a failing test first, making it pass, then cleaning up.

skills.name: Agile Delivery
skills.description: Plans and ships work in short iterations, uses feedback and keeps a working product at each step.

skills.name: Code Quality and Refactoring
skills.description: Improves the structure of working code without changing behaviour, guided by readability and tests.

skills.name: Requirements and User Stories
skills.description: Turns a need into clear, testable requirements and acceptance criteria.

skills.name: REST API Design
skills.description: Designs resource-oriented HTTP interfaces with consistent naming, status codes, errors and versioning.

skills.name: Authentication and Authorization
skills.description: Separates who a user is from what they may do, and protects endpoints with sessions or tokens.

skills.name: HTTP Fundamentals
skills.description: Understands requests, responses, methods, headers, status codes and how the web uses them.

skills.name: SQL Query Basics
skills.description: Retrieves and filters rows with SELECT, WHERE, ORDER BY and LIMIT.

skills.name: SQL Joins
skills.description: Combines tables with inner and outer joins and reasons about row counts after a join.

skills.name: SQL Aggregation and Grouping
skills.description: Summarises data with aggregate functions, GROUP BY and HAVING.

skills.name: SQL Subqueries and CTEs
skills.description: Structures multi-step queries with subqueries and common table expressions.

skills.name: SQL Window Functions
skills.description: Computes rankings, running totals and comparisons across rows without collapsing them.

skills.name: Indexing and Query Performance
skills.description: Speeds up queries with indexes and reads query plans to find what is slow.

skills.name: Transactions and ACID
skills.description: Keeps data correct under concurrent change using transactions, isolation levels and constraints.

skills.name: Scalability Basics
skills.description: Reasons about load, bottlenecks and the trade-offs of scaling a service up or out.

skills.name: Caching Strategies
skills.description: Decides what to cache and where, and handles staleness and invalidation.

skills.name: Processes and Threads
skills.description: Explains how programs run as processes and threads and how the operating system schedules them.

skills.name: Concurrency Basics
skills.description: Writes code that shares data safely between threads using locks and avoids races and deadlocks.

skills.name: Command Line Basics
skills.description: Navigates the file system and combines shell commands to inspect and transform files.

skills.name: Spreadsheet Formulas and Functions
skills.description: Builds reliable calculations with lookup, logical, text and date functions.

skills.name: Pivot Tables
skills.description: Summarises large tables by category and period using pivot tables and charts.

skills.name: Handling Missing Values
skills.description: Detects missing data, understands why it is missing and chooses to drop, fill or flag it.

skills.name: Deduplication and Standardization
skills.description: Finds duplicate records and makes inconsistent text, dates and categories uniform.

skills.name: Data Validation Checks
skills.description: Defines and runs checks that catch impossible, inconsistent or out-of-range data before analysis.

skills.name: Descriptive Statistics
skills.description: Summarises data with centre, spread and shape, and chooses measures that suit the data.

skills.name: Hypothesis Testing
skills.description: Tests a claim with a null hypothesis, a test statistic and a p-value, and states what the result means.

skills.name: Correlation and Regression Basics
skills.description: Measures how variables move together and fits a simple line while avoiding causal over-claims.

skills.name: Sampling and Confidence Intervals
skills.description: Draws conclusions about a population from a sample and states the uncertainty.

skills.name: Random Variables and Distributions
skills.description: Describes uncertain quantities with common distributions and computes expectations.

skills.name: Conditional Probability and Bayes' Rule
skills.description: Updates beliefs with new evidence using conditional probability and Bayes' rule.

skills.name: Data Wrangling with Pandas
skills.description: Loads, reshapes, joins and summarises tabular data with pandas.

skills.name: Data Visualization with Python
skills.description: Plots distributions and relationships with Python libraries and labels them clearly.

skills.name: NumPy Arrays
skills.description: Computes on whole arrays at once with vectorised operations, broadcasting and indexing.

skills.name: Chart Selection
skills.description: Picks the chart that shows a comparison, trend, part-to-whole or relationship honestly.

skills.name: Dashboard Design
skills.description: Lays out a dashboard so the main question is answered at a glance and filters stay simple.

skills.name: KPI and Metric Definition
skills.description: Defines a metric precisely, with its formula, grain and exclusions, so everyone reads it the same way.

skills.name: Exploratory Data Analysis
skills.description: Explores a new dataset to understand its shape, quality and patterns before modelling or reporting.

skills.name: A/B Test Analysis
skills.description: Designs and reads a controlled experiment, including sample size, significance and practical effect.

skills.name: Cohort and Funnel Analysis
skills.description: Tracks groups over time and step-by-step drop-off to explain retention and conversion.

skills.name: Data Storytelling
skills.description: Turns analysis into a clear message for a decision-maker, with the evidence and the caveats.

skills.name: Vectors and Matrices
skills.description: Represents data as vectors and matrices and uses dot products, norms and matrix multiplication.

skills.name: Eigenvalues and Matrix Decomposition
skills.description: Understands eigenvectors and decompositions such as SVD and where they appear in data work.

skills.name: Regression Models
skills.description: Predicts a number from features with linear and related models and reads their coefficients.

skills.name: Classification Models
skills.description: Predicts a category with models such as logistic regression and reads their outputs.

skills.name: Model Evaluation and Metrics
skills.description: Chooses and interprets metrics such as accuracy, precision, recall, F1 and error measures.

skills.name: Overfitting and Regularization
skills.description: Recognises a model that memorises its training data and controls it with regularization and simpler models.

skills.name: Cross-Validation
skills.description: Estimates how a model will do on new data with held-out folds and avoids leaking information.

skills.name: Feature Engineering
skills.description: Creates, encodes and scales input features that make patterns easier for a model to learn.

skills.name: Tree-Based Models
skills.description: Uses decision trees and ensembles such as random forests and boosting.

skills.name: Clustering and Unsupervised Learning
skills.description: Finds structure in unlabeled data with clustering and judges whether it is meaningful.

skills.name: Dimensionality Reduction
skills.description: Compresses many features into a few with methods such as PCA while keeping what matters.

skills.name: Optimization and Gradient Descent
skills.description: Minimises a loss by following its gradient and understands learning rate and convergence.

skills.name: Model Deployment Basics
skills.description: Packages a trained model behind an interface, versions it and watches it after release.

skills.name: Neural Network Fundamentals
skills.description: Explains layers, activations and loss, and builds a small network end to end.

skills.name: Backpropagation and Training
skills.description: Understands how gradients flow backward and trains a network with batches, epochs and optimizers.

skills.name: Convolutional Networks
skills.description: Uses convolution and pooling to learn from images and other grid-like data.

skills.name: Transformers and Attention
skills.description: Explains self-attention and how transformer models process sequences.

skills.name: Text Preprocessing
skills.description: Cleans and tokenizes text and chooses normalisation steps that suit the task.

skills.name: Word and Sentence Embeddings
skills.description: Represents words and sentences as vectors and uses them for search and similarity.

skills.name: Responsible AI and Bias
skills.description: Spots bias, privacy and safety risks in data and models and applies basic mitigations.
